_purpose: What a page reading of a filing says about premium by line of business, for a record whose extracted mix names no line of business (the PC page readings of 5 October 2026; decisions of the Claude analysis session of 5 October 2026, reported to the owner). run_analysis.py (load_and_classify, load_composition_page_readings) reads it. filing_prints_lines true: the filing prints premium amounts by line although every model's mix names none: the extraction lost the lines, and the record is composition_unavailable with the reason 'extraction_lost_lines' (in the target, no weights; the mix is not rebuilt from the page, D3-1 chose against remapping). filing_prints_lines false: the filing prints no premium amount for any non-life line, whatever another model read: the record is out of scope with the entry's scope_reason (6107/2024 is the one where another model read lines). THE RULE: a book is out of scope only if its filing prints no premium amount for any non-life line of business; life books are out of scope as life business (their filings print a life premium, which is not a non-life line). Lines named in words, or as percentages, without amounts stay out of scope (557, 6104, 6117, 6129, 6133, 2689, 1971/2021, 5623/2021, 1910/2022, 6107/2024; the 23 life records are genuine life books). Every scope exclusion is page-read: the register holds a false entry for each of the 64 (35 contract form only, 6 channel only, 23 life), so the repository holds every reading the scope rests on; the loader's evidence for such a record names the page reading. A quote is copied from the page reports and none is invented; verbatim_quote says whether it is a verbatim copy of its page: true, or false with a quote_kind: cross_reference (it refers to another year's quote, 'the same ...', instead of repeating it), summary, or partial_quote (verbatim page strings in quotation marks joined by the reading's own labels, units and annotations, such as 'only', '= the gross written premium' or a pointer to a page without its text). A page reading outranks the model readings in both directions, so an entry also settles a record another model would have made readers_disagree (6118/2016 true, 6107/2024 false); readers_disagree remains for a record no page has been read for, and is empty on the current data. Each entry needs filing_prints_lines, the pages read (a filing published as HTML carries html: true), where, a quote, the reading, source_file and source_sha256 (the hash of the filing as downloaded) and, for true, the lines with a positive amount_m in the report's currency (a negative adjustment is not a line; a channel such as MGA Insurance goes in channel_amounts; an amount the page states but the quote does not itemise goes in not_itemised_m), or, for false, the scope_reason. An entry marked _to_complete is skipped, and the run log names it. The register is a hashed input of the run id.
_status: Twelve records with filing_prints_lines true (6103 for 2016, 2017, 2018, 2019, 2021, 2022 and 2024, 6118/2015, 6118/2016, 6123/2017, 6132/2020 and 2357/2017) and 64 with false: 6107/2024 and the other 63 scope exclusions (contract form only, channel only and life), from the PC's page reading of the 74 scope exclusions and the readers_disagree records on 5 October 2026. Eleven entries have two readings: the PC page reading and the stage-3 verifier's independent check of every quote and amount against the filing (second_reading). 6118/2016 and 6107/2024 have one reading each, the PC's page readings, and a second is added only where a quote check confirms it. The other 63 scope exclusions rest on the PC's page reading, one reading each.
